messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large quadrupedal creature standing in side profile facing right, with the overall shape and fur of a brown bear but with glossy beetle-like armor fused into its body. Dense long shaggy brown fur covers the body, darker brown on the back and legs and pale creamy tan on the chest and belly. The head is bear-like with a long tan muzzle, black nose, dark eyes, and two small rounded furry ears. A single long glossy black curved horn with side notches and a forked tip rises from the top of the forehead. Dark reddish-brown to black shiny exoskeleton plates are embedded in the fur across the back, flank, shoulder hump, throat, and around the leg joints and ankles, including large ridged wing-case-like panels on the mid-side. Small dark oval holes are visible in the fur beside some plates. It stands on four thick furry legs ending in broad clawed paws, with a short furry stub tail at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with long tan muzzle, black nose, dark eyes and closed mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with small side prongs and a forked tip", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head between the ears, curving up and forward"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown furry bear legs with lighter fur on the inner and underside", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short small furry brown stub", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown to black beetle exoskeleton plates, including ridged wing-case-like panels on the side and back and smooth joint guards, with small dark oval breathing holes in the surrounding fur", "part": "plates", "where": "embedded in the fur across the back, mid-flank, shoulder hump, throat, and around the upper and lower leg joints"}, {"looks_like": "dense long shaggy brown fur, darker on back and legs and creamy white-tan on chest and belly", "part": "coat", "where": "covering the entire body except for the horn, nose, claws and exoskeleton plates"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
